remarks: Phenomenal penthouse apartment with views of LI sound and NYC in the distance. Renovated 4 years ago with new flooring, bathroom, appliances and new A/C units. Clean and move in ready. Corner, top floor unit with plenty of sunlight. Large balcony off of living room. Complex has a 24 hour guard and a lovely swimming pool with plenty of lounge chairs. Assigned outdoor parking for 1 car. Easy to show.
